# Changes here are hard to undo, so a PR touching them needs a passing council review to merge
# (.github/council.toml, .github/workflows/council.yml). Everything else merges on green CI. One glob per line; **
# spans folders.
# Add a path when a mistake there would lose players' data, slow every server, or let a change skip these checks.

# The checks themselves: a PR could otherwise switch off what reviews it. Build files can drop coverageCheck, the
# fast tests or a PIT threshold, so they count too.
.github/**
# The review's own instructions: weakening them weakens the record the gate trusts.
.claude/skills/council/**
.claude/skills/questions/**
.claude/skills/explain/**
# The priority table there decides when the council stops.
docs/coding-standards.md
gradle/**
**build.gradle.kts
settings.gradle.kts
gradle.properties

# Saved data formats: a wrong change here loses players' data on every server that updates.

neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/data/**

# Hot paths: these run millions of times a second, so a slow change slows every server.
